# Helpio

> Complete global directory of verified helplines — mental health, domestic violence, addiction, veterans, LGBTQ+, seniors and more in 50+ countries. Call, text, chat or email. Free & confidential.

Publisher: Cropzeq Technologies | Mr. Mukeshkumar Parmar
Contact: yourtimesstart@gmail.com
Domain: https://www.helpio.online
Languages: English, Español, हिन्दी, Français, ગુજરાતી, Deutsch, Português, العربية, Nederlands, Italiano, Русский, 中文, 日本語, 한국어, Türkçe

## About

Helpio is a free public-service website that organizes the most important helplines, hotlines, crisis lines, text and chat services of 50+ countries into one searchable directory. It is NOT an emergency service. In a life-threatening emergency, call your local emergency number.

## Helpline Categories Covered

For every country, Helpio lists verified lines across these categories:

1. **Emergency** — Police, Ambulance, Fire & Rescue (e.g., 911 US, 999 UK, 112 Europe, 000 Australia, 110/119 Japan, 100/108 India)
2. **Women Support** — domestic violence, gender-based violence, women's crisis lines (e.g., US 1-800-799-7233, UK 0808 2000 247, India 181, France 3919)
3. **Child Support** — child helplines, missing & exploited children (e.g., US 1-800-843-5678, UK 0800 1111, India 1098)
4. **Mental Health & Crisis** — suicide prevention and crisis counseling (e.g., 988 US/CA, 116 123 UK, Tele-MANAS 14416 India)
5. **Cyber Crime** — online fraud, scams, cybercrime reporting (e.g., US FBI IC3, UK Action Fraud 0300 123 2040, India 1930)
6. **Railway Helpline** — rail safety, security and assistance (e.g., US Amtrak Police 1-800-331-0008, UK BTP 0800 40 50 40 + text 61016, India 139 & 182)
7. **Disaster Management** — disaster relief, civil defense, emergency management (e.g., US FEMA 1-800-621-3362, India NDMA 1078, Brazil Defesa Civil 199)
8. **Addiction & Recovery**
9. **Health & Medical**
10. **General Support**

All national crisis lines are free and confidential. Most provide interpreters in multiple languages.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

### United States
- Emergency: 911
- Suicide & Crisis Lifeline: **988** (call/text, 24/7). Chat: 988lifeline.org
- Crisis Text Line: text **HOME to 741741**
- National Domestic Violence Hotline: **1-800-799-7233** (text START to 88788)
- RAINN Sexual Assault: **1-800-656-4673**
- Poison Control: **1-800-222-1222** (24/7)
- Veterans Crisis Line: **1-800-273-8255** (press 1) or text 838255
- SAMHSA (addiction & mental health): **1-800-662-4357**
- Trevor Project (LGBTQ+ youth): **1-866-488-7386**
- Human Trafficking Hotline: **1-888-373-7888** (text 233733)
- Cyber Crime (FBI IC3): **ic3.gov**
- Railway (Amtrak Police): **1-800-331-0008**
- Disaster (FEMA): **1-800-621-3362**

### United Kingdom
- Emergency: 999 / 112
- Samaritans: **116 123** (24/7)
- Childline: **0800 1111**
- National Domestic Abuse Helpline: **0808 2000 247**
- Shout text: **85258**
- Cyber Crime (Action Fraud): **0300 123 2040**
- Railway (British Transport Police): **0800 40 50 40** (text 61016)
- Floodline (disaster): **0345 988 1188**

### Australia
- Emergency: 000 / 112
- Lifeline: **13 11 14** (24/7)
- Kids Helpline: **1800 55 1800**
- 1800RESPECT (DV/sexual assault): **1800 737 732**
- Poisons: **13 11 26**
- Cyber (ACSC): **1300 292 371**
- Disaster (SES): **132 500**

### Canada
- Emergency: 911
- Suicide Crisis Helpline: **988**
- Talk Suicide: **1-833-456-4566**
- Kids Help Phone: **1-800-668-6868** (text CONNECT to 686868)
- Poison Control: **1-844-764-7669**
- Anti-Fraud Centre: **1-888-495-8501**
- Railway (CN Police): **1-800-465-9239**

### India
- Emergency: 112 / Police 100 / Ambulance 108
- Tele-MANAS mental health: **14416**
- KIRAN suicide prevention: **1800-599-0019**
- Childline: **1098**
- Women Helpline: **181**
- Cyber Crime: **1930**
- Railway: **139** (enquiry) / **182** (RPF security)
- Disaster (NDMA): **1078**

### Germany
- Emergency: 112 / Police 110
- TelefonSeelsorge: **0800 111 0 111** (24/7)
- Hilfetelefon Gewalt gegen Frauen: **08000 116 016**
- Railway (DB Sicherheit): **0800 141 41 41**

### France
- Emergency: 112 / SAMU 15
- Suicide prevention: **3114** (24/7)
- Violences Femmes: **3919**
- Enfance en danger: **119**
- Cyber (Cybermalveillance): **0 805 805 817**
- Railway (SNCF): **3117**

### Japan
- Emergency: 110 / 119
- Inochi no Denwa: **0120-783-556**
- TELL (English): **03-5774-0992**
- Cyber Police: **#9110**
- Disaster info: **bousai.go.jp**

- Singapore: 999/995 · SOS **1767** · ScamShield **1800 722 6688**
